➡️Ready to buy a new home in the Central Texas area? Schedule a call here: https://calendly.com/soldwithkyla/30min
 
I work with buyers and sellers throughout Central TX. Whether you're looking to buy land to build a custom home, already living local and looking to move for life changes, or you'll just be in Central Texas for a few years stationed at Fort Hood or completing you're Residency at BS&W, I've got you covered. 

Moving to or from Fort Hood or Central TX? We have real estate partners around the world to help get you sold and into a new home at your next destination!

Areas we cover: Temple, Belton, Salado, Troy, Killeen, Fort Hood, Harker Heights, Nolanville, Copperas Cove, Gatesville, Greater Waco area, and Greater Austin area. 

Kyla Montano | Licensed Texas REALTOR® (775318)

Welcome to our latest video, your exclusive access to an insightful interview with Bryna Dixon of Tierra Custom Home Builders, where we unveil their latest stunning new build in Holland, Texas! 

Tierra Custom Home Builders are renowned for their exquisite homes, tailor-made to suit the unique lifestyle requirements of clients throughout Central Texas. In this compelling interview, we get in-depth about their construction timeline, floor plan options, varied customization choices, and pricing. This video is an absolute goldmine for those considering taking the leap towards fulfilling their luxury custom home dreams. 

If you are passionate about real estate, in particular, custom home building, this video is choreographed with you in mind. Our conversation with Bryna sheds light on the quality that sets Tierra Custom Home Builders apart from the rest. How are their homes reflections of the tastes and preferences of homeowners, you ask? Well, watch the video to find out!

We take an intimate tour around the beautiful home and highlight its standout features. You'll get a sense of the floor plan possibilities and how Tierra Custom Home Builders use space, function, and aesthetic to build the perfect home. 

In the world of real estate, information is key. The more you know, the better the decisions you can make. That's why our channel is dedicated to bringing you informative, enjoyable, and insider access to home builders throughout central Texas with in-depth looks at how homes come to life from the ground up!

Comment below and tell us what you think about this stunning new build in Holland, Texas and don't forget to hit that thumbs-up button if you found the video informative! Subscribe to our channel to stay updated with more Builder Showcases. 

If you're ready to make a move in Central Texas book a one-on-one call with Kyla and let's work together to find you the perfect build! ➡️ https://calendly.com/soldwithkyla/30min

Enjoy!
